# Generated by exhibition; rebuild by regenerating this project.
#
# Portable CMake build (Linux, macOS, and Windows via MSVC or MinGW),
# matching the RT side. No platform-specific link libraries are needed:
# termios is in libc and ReadFile/WriteFile in kernel32; threads come
# from the imported Threads::Threads target.
#
# Configure and build with the bundled Ninja presets:
#   cmake --preset Debug
#   cmake --build --preset Debug
# The binary lands at build/Debug/exhibition_bc[.exe].
#
# Sources are auto-discovered with file(GLOB), so hand-written code
# dropped into user/ (or alongside the generated files) is built without
# editing this file and survives regeneration. CONFIGURE_DEPENDS re-globs
# on build so a newly added source is picked up without re-configuring.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(exhibition_bc CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

file(GLOB SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/communication/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/host/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/user/*.cpp")

add_executable(exhibition_bc ${SOURCES})

target_include_directories(exhibition_bc PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/communication"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/host")

# The host Logger runs its file writer on a std::thread.
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(exhibition_bc PRIVATE Threads::Threads)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(exhibition_bc PRIVATE /W3)
else()
    target_compile_options(exhibition_bc PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
